intro: Ghana is a stable presidential democracy, often praised as a model in West Africa.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for four years, up to two terms. John Mahama returned as president in 2025. Parliament has 276 seats. Traditional chiefs remain important in local life.

chapters.title: Pan-African role
text: Ghana helped found the Organisation of African Unity and hosts the secretariat of the African Continental Free Trade Area.
